title: Reverse flatness comparison for polynomial chart stalks
statement: theorem polynomial_chart_stalk_flat_comparison_reverse {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T] (f : X ⟶ T) [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (U : X.Opens) [IsAffine U.toScheme] (n : ℕ) (e : U.toScheme ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation e] (he : e ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T ↘ T) = U.ι ≫ f) (x : U.toScheme) : (PolynomialChart.stalkMap f U n e he x).Flat → (e.stalkMap x).hom.Flat

source.place: Tag 00RH, application of the local criterion in Tag 00R7; arbitrary base rings allowed.

proof.text: Apply the local criterion for flatness to the local stalk tower; finite presentation and flatness over the base provide its hypotheses, while the canonical fibre identification supplies the closed-fibre flatness hypothesis.
